verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser documents a dedicated startups and entrepreneurs practice offering 'creative visa solutions', but nothing in the evidence names the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) as an offered pathway or states its qualifying-investment thresholds. General founder-practice claims do not transfer to this specific pathway.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated
